price_field_note: RSF price book (distributed by Associated Energy Systems, in effect June 3rd 2025) publishes a single 'Retail Price' column only. There is no separate dealer/wholesale column, so msrp is populated and dealer_price is left null. RSF appliances are high-efficiency wood-burning fireplaces; fuel_type is 'wood' and ignition is null (manual wood lighting). Models listed are the fireplace bodies only; blowers, vent kits, trims, louvers, liner parts and other line items are recorded under accessories_required where a selection is mandatory for a complete unit.
